offering_description.value: Sells ethylene and related petrochemical coproducts primarily to its parent company and other industrial buyers. It controls the operating partnership that produces ethylene at three steam crackers and operates an ethylene pipeline.

primary_products.value: Ethylene; propylene; crude butadiene; pyrolysis gasoline; hydrogen

customer_segment.value: B2B: Its parent company and other chemical manufacturers and industrial buyers

end_markets.value: Polyethylene and other plastics; vinyls manufacturing; petrochemical intermediates

revenue_model.value: product sales: Ethylene under a long-term supply agreement and sales of ethylene and coproducts to third parties

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Cracks hydrocarbon feedstocks into ethylene and coproducts for chemical manufacturers; asset operator: Operates steam crackers and a pipeline that carries ethylene to downstream chemical plants

geography_served.value: US regional: Production in Louisiana and Kentucky and pipeline operations in Texas

specialization.value: niche specialist: Ethylene production and coproducts from the same cracking process

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Long-term supply agreement with its parent company and direct sales to third-party industrial buyers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Chemical manufacturing and ethylene transport subject to EPA emissions rules, OSHA process safety standards and federal pipeline safety rules
